notes: This manifest is a production planning artifact for the Mogger Mon art replacement pass.
Sprite buckets reflect what the current inherited asset tree actually expects.
Suggested brainrot equivalents are naming prompts, not final canon. Curated rows are strongest starting points.

assetBuckets.description: Root brand assets shown before gameplay loads or when shared as an iframe page.
Main front-facing species and form battle atlases.
Shiny front battle atlases.
Female-specific front battle atlases.
Back-facing player-side battle atlases.
Shiny back battle atlases.
Expanded high-detail front atlases used by some encounter flows.
Expanded high-detail back atlases.
Special regional, mega, gigantamax, and other variant front atlases.
Variant back atlases.
Per-species icon source directories used to assemble party and UI icon sheets.
Prebaked party and dex icon sprite sheets.
Core UI chrome, prompts, selectors, and menu framing.
Character portrait and overworld identity art.
Mogmaster battler art and Mogmaster-adjacent identity sprites.
Battle backgrounds and arena tiles.
Egg art and incubation visuals.
Cutscene and splash artwork.
Battle animation frame sheets and special effects.
Per-species cry audio files if the replacement pass should fully replace inherited creature audio.
Music tracks if the reskin needs a full audio identity.
